children: According to the [announcement](https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/ca3196e008da448da107d397bae0b4b0) from Binance, Binance Futures will launch two USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts to expand trading choices and support users’ trading activity. The PONSUSDT perpetual contract is scheduled to launch on 2026-09-06 06:45 (UTC) with up to 20x leverage, while the 哈基米USDT perpetual contract is scheduled to launch on 2026-09-06 07:15 (UTC) with up to 3x leverage. Both contracts will use USDT as the settlement asset and will trade 24/7. Binance said the contracts will also be available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. The announcement states that PONS (Pons) is a non-custodial token launchpad and native cryptocurrency built on the Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum Layer 2 network, while 哈基米 (Hajimi) is described as a Chinese meme coin. For PONSUSDT, the tick size is 0.0001, the minimum trade amount is 1 PONS, and the minimum notional value is 5 USDT. For 哈基米USDT, the tick size is 0.00001, the minimum trade amount is 1 哈基米, and the minimum notional value is 5 USDT. Both contracts have a capped funding rate of +2.00% / -2.00%, funding fee settlement every four hours, maximum leverage of 3x, and Multi-Assets Mode support. Binance also said contract specifications may be adjusted based on market risk conditions.

title: Binance Futures to Launch PONSUSDT and 哈基米USDT Perpetual Contracts
